The main character, Shuuichi, is a new the new assistant director for the NEK TV. One day, he learns that his mother, Miho, was once a “songstress” who dominated in the past. It was Michiko, a former female TV announcer and a talented producer, who told him about her.

One day, Michiko orders Miho to once again become a songstress. Miho is reluctant to do so, but when her own son is forced to bring up the possibility of getting fired, she decides to take the job. The costume Michiko prepared for Miho was so extreme that even her nipples were visible through the costume!
